eventDo: You return to the elderly man, the werewolf's head in hand. The eyes of the villagers are on you as you approach, surprised by the head of beast.
You return to the elderly man who had asked for your help. He looks at you, then at the head you are carrying.
He nods, "<i>Thank you for taking care of the wolves. I can finally sleep soundly at night.<i>"
You return to the elderly man, unsure of what to say, as you bear no proof of that you completed your task.

msg: The old man pulls out a small pouch, ready to hand it to you. "<i>Here is your reward, as promised.<i>"

actions.action: Take the Reward, and give the Werewolf's Head
